narrative.overview:
The Literature Course Library is a private ledger of one real canon. The page should feel like a warm reading room, the independent-bookstore shelf a reader walks back into. Density is a column of books on bone paper, not a grid of metrics. A library-green band carries the name across the top and the colophon across the bottom. Iron ink does the reading. Vermilion marks the place.

Spectral carries the library's name, the titles, and the guide. Karla carries navigation, buttons, fields, stamps, and metadata. A course row is a raised sheet: a cover fan, a title, a summary, a book count, and a status stamp. Hover or focus lifts that sheet, opens the fan, and draws one vermilion rule under the title. A guide then sits in a 68ch Spectral measure on the bare paper. Status stays a steady stamp: not started, in progress, or read. A score, when it exists, stays on that book's own sheet.

Color is flat. There is no glass and no second theme. Depth is a soft ink shadow under a raised sheet, a stronger lift when the row is active, and a warmer shadow under a cover because the cover is an object on the shelf. The shelf refuses the dark glass dashboard and the floating pill.

Spectral for the name, titles, and reading; Karla for chrome
Vermilion for the place-mark and the primary button; brass for focus; moss when a book is read

rules.name: The Place-Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the place: the progress fill, the primary button, reading links, the back link, and the single rule under a hovered title. It is not a page fill or a card fill.

rules.name: The Stamp Palette Rule
rules.body: Not started is quiet iron on transparent paper. In progress is vermilion on its wash, and the row or course sheet turns to progress paper. Read is moss on its wash, and a finished course rule turns moss.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Spectral carries the library's name, titles, and the guide. Karla carries navigation, buttons, fields, stamps, and metadata. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: A guide is Spectral at 1.125rem, line-height 1.7, inside 68ch, on the paper with no card behind the prose.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Band Rule
rules.body: Library green runs edge to edge in the header and the colophon. The column stops at 1120px, with 24px gutters that become 16px below 800px.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Raised sheets rest on a faint ink shadow. Hover and focus lift a row 3px into the stronger shadow. Covers keep their own object shadow. There is no zero-blur hard shadow and no glass blur.

rules.name: The Stillness Rule
rules.body: When the reader prefers reduced motion, transitions collapse and the row, the linked sheet, and the button do not move.

rules.name: The Corner Scale Rule
rules.body: Stamps are 2px, fan leaves are 3px, covers are 4px, controls are 6px, sheets are 8px, and the dialog is 12px. Progress rules are square-ended.

rules.name: The Cover Fan Rule
rules.body: Hover or focus on a course row opens the cover fan and draws one vermilion rule under the title.

rules.name: The Brass Focus Rule
rules.body: Links, buttons, summaries, and fields take a 2px brass outline, 3px outside the edge.

dos: Do set the page on bone paper and run library green full-bleed through the header and the colophon.
Do set the wordmark, titles, and guide prose in Spectral, and set navigation, buttons, fields, and stamps in Karla.
Do keep a guide in a 68ch Spectral measure at 1.125rem and line-height 1.7, on the paper, with no sheet behind the prose.
Do mark the place with vermilion: the progress fill, the primary button, reading links, and the single rule under a hovered course title.
Do mark keyboard focus with a 2px brass outline, 3px outside the control.
Do stamp status in uppercase Karla at 12px, weight 700, tracking 0.06em, with a 2px corner.
Do lift a course row on hover and focus, open the cover fan, and draw the vermilion rule. Drop that motion when the reader prefers reduced motion.
Do keep body text at or above 4.5:1 against its paper.
donts: Don't build a dark glass dashboard. There is no dark theme, no backdrop blur, and no translucent panel over the paper.
Don't use a floating pill for navigation, buttons, or status. A status dot and a score thumb stay circular because they are points on a control.
Don't fill a page or a card with vermilion. The wash belongs to the in-progress stamp.
Don't set the guide in Karla, and don't set buttons or stamps in Spectral.
Don't use a zero-blur hard offset shadow.
Don't replace the progress rule with a ring, a sparkline, or a scoreboard. A score stays on the book's own sheet.
